description: Pistes cyclables du territoire de la Communauté d'Agglomération Portes de France - Thionville (57) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoagglo-thionville.fr. The linear data presented locate the hair of the linear lines of the community and communal cycle paths of the territory of the APCFT. It distinguishes the two-way tracks, on separate tracks, etc., as well as the type of coating. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle paths in the territory of the Communauté d'Agglomération Portes de France - Thionville (57)" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
